notes: Rows are emitted only when the number, harness/config and fetched URL are all present.
swebench.com rows require checked=true; vendor submissions (checked=false) are rejected.
Open Agent Leaderboard uses a fixed neutral scaffold (tool_calling), never max-across-agents.
Terminal-Bench 4.1 rows are official-leaderboard submissions reviewed by maintainers; the 2.1/2.0 tabs are client-rendered and were not machine-readable.
GAIA rows are matched but cannot be written: the project's canonicalizer excludes GAIA.
HF SWE-bench Verified leaderboard rows are model-card self-reports (verified=false) and are excluded.
Rows in 'blocked' name proposed source ids that do not yet exist in data/sources/; D2 must add those records, then re-run this tool to promote them.
